purpose: SPEAKER IDENTITY — map a messaging identity to a TENANT, so the treasury knows WHO is asking before it decides WHAT it may do (Jordan, 2026-09-20: 'being able to tell the identities of me versus my cousin... who's speaking, who's asking about what strategies').
the_hole_this_closes: Before this file, the guards checked WHERE (rails, addresses) and never WHO. Every message carries a platform-assigned sender id, but nothing consumed it. So any member of a group chat could ask the treasury to move capital and it could not tell them apart from the operator. Attribute BEFORE acting.
hard_rule: AN UNKNOWN SPEAKER GETS NO PRIVILEGE - not Jordan's, not a default, not 'probably fine'. The resolver returns UNKNOWN and every privileged path refuses. An unrecognised sender is an error state, never a permissive one: the failure mode of guessing wrong here is someone else's capital moving.
why_platform_ids_not_display_names: The sender id is assigned by the platform and cannot be set by the user. Display names can be changed to anything, including to the operator's name, so a name is a claim and an id is a fact. Never authorise on a name.

7105876857.label: Jordan (Vanito)
7105876857.notes: Observed as the origin of treasury sessions; the operator and the loss owner.

unmapped_policy.behaviour: Answer questions about public market data if asked, because that is a shared library and costs nothing. Refuse everything else - no positions, no capital, no config, no strategy changes - and say plainly that the sender is not recognised. Then offer the one useful thing: tell Jordan, so he can add them deliberately.
unmapped_policy.never: Never infer a tenant from conversational context, tone, claimed name, or the fact that someone is in the right group. Those are all spoofable or guessable; the id is not.

strategy_attribution.note: Jordan's other requirement - 'who's asking about what strategies'. A strategy question must be answered AGAINST THE ASKING TENANT'S OWN BOOK. Jordan asking about COQ gets Jordan's COQ position and watchlist; Dadrian asking gets his. Shared market facts may be reused; positions and theses must not leak across the boundary.
strategy_attribution.rule: Attribute the question before answering it. An answer that mixes two tenants' positions is a data leak even when every number in it is correct.

open: Dadrian's sender id is not known yet - he must message from his own account and be ADDED deliberately by Jordan, not auto-enrolled on first contact.
No call site consumes resolve_speaker() yet. Same honest gap as assert_autonomy: the guard exists, the wiring does not.

group_rosters.why: Jordan 2026-09-20: 'we should [have] a list of collaborators in each group.' A speaker map alone answers 'who is this id'; it does not answer 'is this person in THIS room'. Without the group check, membership of one group would silently grant standing in another - and a stranger added to the Entertainment group would be one message away from the treasury group's privileges.
group_rosters.rule: Resolve the pair (group, sender). Both must match. A recognised speaker in the WRONG group has the privileges of a stranger in this one: none. Being on the roster is scoped to the room, not to the person.
